text_block_list.text:
Entering the final adjustment phase ahead 
of the Classic Triple Crown's first leg, 
the Satsuki Sho, Symboli Rudolf's 
concentration was nothing short of 
extraordinary...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...!

It is proof that she is in complete 
control of her own pace.

At her own request, we've increased her 
training intensity since her debut... and 
the results are clearly showing!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
How was it, Trainer-kun? My running, that 
is.

With this, the Satsuki Sho will surely—! 
Just as I was about to say that—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —President.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Brian. Doesn't look like you're... 
training.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yeah. We have a problem. Get over here.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-kun, I'm going to step out for 
a bit. Is that alright?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Is that not so? Then my problems are your 
problems.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Understood. Please do.

When I rushed over to the student council 
room, I could hear voices faintly leaking 
through the door.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "...Are you serious? Still... with..."

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Affairs
text_block_list.text: However... so...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Coming in.
(Click...)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President?! Why are you—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Brian, is it? Why did you inform the 
President?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: If they're not here, it's a non-starter.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Still, you were training, weren't you? To 
force you to—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove, I have already decided to go. 
More importantly, tell me what happened.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, this is a problem I can handle on my 
own—

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Affairs
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry...! It's all my fault!!

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Affairs
text_block_list.text:
I can't do this anymore...! Please, let me 
resign from the student council...!
(Pitter-patter... *click*)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ah! Wait—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Air Groove. There's something I need 
to confirm with you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Brian, go in my place.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Air Groove. Is this matter the 
same issue you previously mentioned you 
would report?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I apologize for not being able to 
resolve this.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to apologize. Would you 
mind giving your report right here, right 
now?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes. She had previously submitted a 
request to resign from the student 
council.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Why?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
She said she "lacked confidence." I 
suspect it is because the tasks assigned 
to her kept stalling.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...She also said she didn't want to hold 
back our great President any further."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That said, she still lacks experience. 
I've tried to hold her back, telling her 
it's too early to give up on herself, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I know how hard you've worked. ...I'm 
sorry for leaving everything to you.
(Click...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I brought them.

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Affairs
text_block_list.text: ...*pant*... *gasp*... ngh.
choice_data_list:
(I wonder if someone was chasing after 
them...)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Good work, Brian.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now then—you.

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Affairs
text_block_list.text: I-I am terribly sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Please, don't be so modest. I only have 
one request."

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Affairs
text_block_list.text: Wait, a favor...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I will now challenge the dream of the 
Classic Triple Crown. Will you come watch 
my first race?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Just like before, I'd like you to see it 
with your own eyes. Well? Will you agree 
to it?

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Affairs
text_block_list.text: ...? U-Understood...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have your word on that. Now then, 
everyone, we are dismissed for today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it, Air Groove. Leave it 
to me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's get back to training. 
Trainer-kun, shall we continue?

Symboli Rudolf seemed to have an idea. Not 
knowing how she planned to settle the 
situation, I returned to training...
